headline: U.S. lifts Iran oil sanctions. And, federal judge rules SAVE voter tool unlawful
context: The U.S. has temporarily lifted oil sanctions on Iran as peace talks continue. And, a federal judge ruled that the Trump administration's data system, known as SAVE, is unlawful.
